edit.description: costUsd on AgentUsage; lift it at the result-event decode
the verdict's invocation row carries it

summary: Lift the agent's reported cost onto AgentUsage as costUsd, so the verdict's usage row carries it per §The tick verdict.

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

tests: the usage decode lifts the result event's total_cost_usd onto costUsd
a tick verdict's invocation row carries the agent's reported costUsd
acceptance: costUsd is set from the result event at the same decode as the token fields, and reaches invocations[] in the tick verdict.
notes: The one result-event field AgentUsage did not carry; two surveyed consumer chains re-scan raw stdout for it (docs/surveys/consumer-chains/INDEX.md #3). Absent per field when the agent does not report it, like its siblings.

edit.description: both fields required; the fixture-compat narration shrinks
drop the three commitSha absence refusals

summary: Make GateContext.commitSha and baseSha required per §What a gate receives, and delete every absence guard behind them.
tests: GateContext.commitSha is required, so a gate context omitting it is a type error
GateContext.baseSha is required, so a gate context omitting it is a type error
acceptance: Both fields are required on GateContext; no builtin gate or example carries a fallback or refusal for either being absent.
notes: Third and fourth fields of the same amendment — touchedPaths (66e25dd) and stateRootRel (188c72e) shipped the shape, including the type-level judge in tests/Gate.test.ts these two cases join. All three dispatcher-built contexts already set both unconditionally.

edit.description: renderSection: Breaking leads, Uncategorized heads the rest

summary: Close the mined draft's ### Breaking with an ### Uncategorized subheading over the non-breaking entries, per §Versioning policy.
tests: the mined draft renders every non-breaking entry under an ### Uncategorized subheading
the mined draft renders ### Breaking ahead of ### Uncategorized
acceptance: A draft holding both kinds leads with ### Breaking and closes with ### Uncategorized over the rest.
notes: Inverts the current order, which leads with an unheaded flat list to keep it out of ### Breaking. Spec is silent on a draft with one empty bucket; keep the renderer's standing convention — a heading renders iff its bucket is non-empty.
